i01-sofia-invites.observed_description: Sofia in a yellow blouse stands in her open apartment door beside colorful balloons and holds out an open hand toward a guest whose shoulder and the back of whose head show at the right edge.
i01-sofia-invites.note: Usable: the invitation reads at 180 px; the model added the guest seen from behind at the edge, who has no line (kept, as in 3.1). Two people, so the speaker registry anchors Sofia.

i02-luis-love-to.observed_description: Luis (navy T-shirt) stands on a sunny sidewalk by an apartment building, laughing with one hand on his chest, turned toward the left edge.
i02-luis-love-to.note: Usable: a delighted yes reads at 180 px; nobody else is visible.

i03-diego-busy.observed_description: Diego (burgundy shirt) sits at an office desk buried in piles of papers and folders behind a laptop and raises one palm with an apologetic face.
i03-diego-busy.note: Usable: busy and sorry read at 250 px. Diego sits right of center, so the photo stays out of four-picture cards (four_card false).
